Put $k=d-2$ and assume no prime $k$th power divides every value of $f$. Then the number of positive integers $n\le X$ for which $f(n)$ is $k$-free is $c_fX+o_f(X)$, where $c_f>0$ is the convergent product of local factors. Negative values are allowed and zero is excluded. No monicity, primitivity, or coefficient-height restriction is imposed.” Quoted, not judged: AMVO has not compared this Lean statement with the family's claims or with the manuscripts.
